photos.name: 01-boule-on-steel-mid-bake
photos.summary: Sourdough boule mid-bake on a pizza steel inside the oven, showing an X score pattern with modest oven spring and pale crust still developing color.

photos.name: 02-finished-loaf-crust-closeup
photos.summary: Close-up of the finished loaf cooling on a wire rack, showing a deep golden-brown crust with visible score lines and a slightly flat profile consistent with over-fermented dough.

photos.name: 03-dough-after-bulk-ferment
photos.summary: Dough after bulk ferment in a glass mixing bowl, appearing slack and spread out with visible surface bubbles, showing signs of over-fermentation.

photos.name: 04-active-starter
photos.summary: Active sourdough starter at peak in a tall jar with a timing band, risen to the top and domed above the rim, covered with a cloth cap.
